battle.name: 虎牢之戰
battle.brief: 武德四年（621年）五月，夏王竇建德引眾十餘萬、號稱三十萬，南下馳援洛陽王世充。李世民率軍東征，先拔衛州，再據虎牢關按兵不動，待其列陣疲極，遣三百騎登坡鼓噪，隨即捲旗率精騎直衝陣後，斬首三千餘級、俘虜五萬餘人，生擒竇建德，河北遂平。卡面羅馬弩砲未至，投射技術與唐軍床弩同屬一脉。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 虎牢之戰是隋末唐初爭奪中原與河北的決定性會戰，交戰三方是唐、夏與洛陽的鄭。北方是唐高祖李淵建立的唐帝國：都長安，關中為根本，太子李建成以留守京師、總攬朝政為職，實際出征由秦王李世民全權統帥，長史劉殷基、殷開山與宇文士及等幕僚將校隨軍，關中、隴右、並州以及山東歸附諸州的兵丁馬匹供應東征大軍。東面是竇建德在河北建立的夏國：都樂壽，竇氏原為隋末河北地方強人，糾集鄉里與散卒，盡有河北諸州，故其兵眾號稱三十萬而實約十餘萬，軍中多河北舊部與新附之眾，騎兵是其倚重。另一方是王世充篡隋所建的鄭：定都洛陽，控弦當天下之中，被唐軍圍困日久，屢向竇建德求援；唐、夏兩家表面修好，實則互相窺伺。三方之中，唐據上游而糧道可通，夏處下游而河北人心未定，鄭居其中而自求多福；虎牢一役，實為唐、夏兩家面對面的總清算。
countriesEn: The Battle of Hulao was the decisive engagement of the struggle for the Central Plain and the North China Plain in the late Sui and early Tang, and three sides took part in it: Tang, Xia, and the Zheng regime at Luoyang. In the north stood the Tang empire founded by Li Yuan, the Gaozu Emperor: its capital was Chang'an, the Guanzhong basin was its base, the crown prince Li Jiancheng remained at the capital to oversee the court, and the expedition was led in the field by the Prince of Qin, Li Shimin, with amirs such as Liu Yinji, Yin Kaishan and Yuwen Shiji in attendance, and with soldiers and horses drawn from Guanzhong, Longyou, Bingzhou and the Shandong prefectures that had already submitted. To the east stood the Xia kingdom of Dou Jiande in Hebei: its capital was Leshou, and Dou had begun as a local Hebei strongman who gathered the villages and scattered troops of the late Sui, and having absorbed the other Hebei powers he held most of that region's prefectures; his host was proclaimed at three hundred thousand men but was in truth a little over a hundred thousand, made up largely of Hebei veterans and new recruits, and his cavalry was what he relied upon. The third side was Zheng, the regime Wang Shichong had created by seizing the Sui throne: its capital was Luoyang, dead centre of the empire, and after a long siege it kept begging Dou Jiande for help; Tang and Xia maintained the fiction of friendship on the surface while each spied on the other. Of the three, Tang held the upper position and its supply line still ran, Xia lay downstream with the hearts of Hebei still unsettled, and Zheng sat in between, looking after itself. Hulao was in effect the settling of accounts between Tang and Xia face to face.
people: 此戰的兩個主角，一個是年方二十三歲的秦王李世民，一個是稱王河北的夏王竇建德。李世民自渭北起兵，先破劉武周、再平劉黑闥，羽檄所至河北震動；此次東征，他率諸軍自洛陽北上，先取衛州，擊破竇建德部將王世度、康蘇乂，掃清河北門戶，再回師南下據虎牢。竇建德生於五七三年，隋末以義軍首領聚眾於貝州，後定都樂壽、兼併鄰郡，成一方之強；然史書評其人貪而少謀，與唐往來屢為所乘。戰局中第三方王世充最為關鍵：竇建德遠道來援，屯兵板渚而糧食不繼，向洛陽求粟，王世充閉口不答，坐觀兩敗。虎牢關前，李世民按兵不動，只令宇文士及率三百騎往陣西南高坡豎唐旗而鼓噪，一時驚動夏軍；號令既下，李世民自引精騎捲旗疾馳，東行北折直插竇軍之背，長史劉殷基、殷開山等皆死鬥，秦叔寶、尉遲敬德等猛將亦在軍中，卒使十餘萬眾一時崩解。竇建德中流矢，匿於牛渚渚中，為追騎所擒，押解長安，至貞觀八年受賜而死。
peopleEn: The two protagonists of this battle were Li Shimin, Prince of Qin, aged twenty-three, and Dou Jiande, the King of Xia in Hebei. Li Shimin had risen in the Wei River valley, had first destroyed Liu Wuzhou and then Liu Heita, and the very reach of his proclamations had shaken Hebei. For this eastern campaign he led the army north from Luoyang, first taking Weizhou and defeating Dou Jiande's generals Wang Shidu and Kang Suxi, which cleared the gateway to Hebei, and then turned back south to take up position at Hulao. Dou Jiande, born in 573, had begun in the last years of the Sui as a leader of a volunteer host in Beizhou; after settling at Leshou and absorbing the neighbouring commanderies he had become one of the strongest powers of the north, yet the histories judge him greedy and short of counsel, and time and again he was outmanoeuvred by Tang. The third party, Wang Shichong, was the pivot of the whole situation: Dou Jiande had marched a long way to relieve him and sat with his troops at Banzhu, but his own food had run out, and when he asked Luoyang for grain Wang Shichong said nothing and waited for one of the two to break first. Before Hulao, Li Shimin held his army still; he only sent Yuwen Shiji with three hundred horsemen to the high slope south-west of the enemy line, where they raised the Tang banner and beat the drums, throwing the Xia host into confusion. When the order went out, Li Shimin led his picked cavalry with the flags furled, rode east and then turned north to strike the Xia line in the rear; the amirs Liu Yinji and Yin Kaishan fought to the death, fierce officers such as Qin Qiong and Yuchi Jingde were in the ranks, and the mass of more than a hundred thousand men broke at once. Dou Jiande was hit by a stray arrow and hid in the marsh at Niuzhu, where the pursuing horsemen took him; he was sent under escort to Chang'an and was granted death there in the eighth year of Zhenguan.
kits: 卡面上這件羅馬弩砲（Scorpio），乃公元前五十年前後羅馬城邦末期常用的扭力弩砲，一發一具重箭，用以壓制城頭守軍與密集步兵陣列，有效射程約在數百公尺之間。它並沒有出現在虎牢——中原文獻從未記錄任何羅馬兵器隨唐軍東征；但它所在的技術譜系，在虎牢戰線上確有對應之物：唐承隋制，軍中有以絞盤蓄力的床弩（五弓床弩）與一石、二石弓，弩手列於步軍前排，專司中遠程壓制；攻城另有砲（拋石機）、飛石、撞車、雲梯、巢車與鉤援一類器械。唐軍在河北與洛陽的攻城戰中確曾以砲與撞車破城，拋出的石彈重達數十斤，可摧女牆；但虎牢之戰屬野戰而非攻城，夏軍遠道而來並無攻城裝備，唐軍所倚者只是既有的關城、地形與兩翼的機動兵力。戰陣上真正落地的殺傷手段是馬槊、方天畫戟、長刀與弓箭，以及唐軍自關中、並州、隴右調集的戰馬所構成的騎兵鋒刃；後勤上唐軍有洛陽與河洛一線的倉廩與河運支應，竇軍自河北南下、行軍數百里，糧道未通而至士卒飢渴，軍中爭飲水、行列散亂，像羅馬弩砲那樣可反覆投射的火力優勢，夏軍根本無從建立。
kitsEn: The card's weapon, the Roman Scorpio, was a torsion catapult in use in Rome in the last years of the Republic, around 50 BC: it threw a single heavy bolt and was used to pin down defenders on walls and dense columns of infantry, with an effective range of a few hundred metres. It was not at Hulao — no Chinese source ever records Roman weapons marching east with a Tang army — but the family of technology to which it belongs does have counterparts on the Hulao front. Tang inherited the Sui system: the army had winch-powered bed crossbows, the five-bow bed crossbow, and bows of one and two piccels, with crossbowmen drawn up in the front rank of the infantry for medium and long range fire, and for siege work there were the traction trebuchet, the stone-thrower, the battering ram, scaling ladders, siege towers and wall hooks. Tang artillery did break cities in Hebei and at Luoyang, where stone shot weighing several tens of jin crushed the parapets; but Hulao was a field battle and not a siege, the Xia army had come with no siege train at all, and the Tang side relied only on the existing pass fortification, on the terrain and on mobile force on both flanks. What actually landed killing blows on the field were the ma spear, the fangtian halberd, the long sword and the bow, together with the cavalry horses mustered from Guanzhong, Bingzhou and Longyou that made up the Tang charge. In logistics the Tang army drew on the granaries and river transport of Luoyang and the Heluo line, while Dou's army, marching several hundred li south from Hebei with its supply route stretched to breaking point, was so short of food that the men fought over water and the ranks came apart; a repeating fire power of the kind the Roman Scorpio offered could not be built up there, for the Xia troops barely had enough bolts to shoot.
tactics: 此戰的關鍵，是把決戰時機、戰場地形與心理戰三件事疊在一起。虎牢關在洛陽東面，關城依嵩山、夾汜水與黃河之際而築，道路狹隘，自北而南只有一條通道；唐軍據關固守，佔盡地利。夏軍自板渚一帶濟河而來，在虎牢東原列陣，據舊籍所記，其營北距河、西薄汜水、南抵鵠嶺，寬敞的地形容得下十餘萬大軍，卻無從施展突擊的騎兵。竇建德屢請交兵，李世民按兵不動，專候其疲。戰前自辰時至午時，夏軍列陣久而不得進，士卒飢渴爭飲水，隊伍前後不能相顧，將吏約束已弛；李世民見其可擊，先命宇文士及將三百騎經陣西南，登高坡執旗下馬休息，以唐旗與鼓噪自西側驚動敵陣，再令諸軍戒嚴待命。號令既下，李世民自引精騎捲旗疾馳，東行而北折，直薄竇軍之背，唐軍步騎隨之而進，兩翼同時合攏。竇軍進退失據，一朝崩潰；唐軍追奔三十里，直至牛渚，竇建德中流矢匿於牛渚渚中，遂被追騎擒獲。這是一場以逸待勞、誘敵於疲、以精騎反轉陣線的典型殲滅戰。
tacticsEn: The key to this battle was the combination of three things: the timing of the decision, the ground, and psychological pressure. Hulao Pass lay east of Luoyang, its fortification built against the Songshan mountains between the Si River and the Yellow River, the road so narrow that there was only one way through from north to south; the Tang army held the pass and had the ground entirely on its side. The Xia army crossed the river in the neighbourhood of Banzhu and drew up on the plain east of Hulao; according to the older records its camp faced the river to the north, ran thinly along the Si River to the west and reached as far south as Hu Ridge — broad ground that would hold more than a hundred thousand men, but ground on which cavalry could not manoeuvre. Dou Jiande repeatedly asked to be engaged; Li Shimin did not move, waiting for him to tire. From the hour of the dragon until midday the Xia army stood in line without advancing, the men hungry and thirsty and jostling for water, files and ranks no longer watching each other, discipline already slack. Judging that the moment had come, Li Shimin first sent Yuwen Shiji with three hundred horsemen round to the south-west of the enemy line, to raise the Tang banner on a high slope and beat the drums, disturbing the Xia formation from the west, and then ordered the whole army to stand ready. When the signal went, Li Shimin led his picked cavalry with flags furled, rode east and turned north, and struck the Xia line in the rear; the Tang foot and horse followed in and the two wings closed at once. The Xia army, with no way forward or back, collapsed; the Tang pursuit ran thirty li, to Niuzhu, where Dou Jiande, hit by an arrow and hidden in the marsh, was taken by the horsemen in pursuit. It was a textbook annihilation won by waiting at ease, wearing the enemy down and turning the line with picked cavalry.
data: 可核對的數字並不多，但幾個要點相當清楚。夏軍的兵眾，《資治通鑑》與《舊唐書》同記為「十餘萬、號稱三十萬」；實際點算當在十萬上下，其中騎兵為其倚重，步兵佔大多數。唐軍方面，東征主力由關中與洛陽兩線集結，兵眾以萬計，騎兵充當鋒銳，另有弓弩手與步卒列陣。戰果有明確記載：斬首三千餘級，俘虜五萬餘人，追奔三十里，竇建德中流矢被擒。戰鬥時辰記作自辰時至午時，即上午七時至正午之間，夏軍列陣兩個時辰不得進，士卒飢渴爭飲水。距離上，虎牢關在洛陽東面數十里，竇建德自河北樂壽南下，行軍數百里，糧道被拉得極長。時間上，此戰繫於武德四年（公元621年）五月辛巳，今人多換算為公元621年5月下旬，月曆換算各家略有出入，然戰事在該年夏初發生則無疑義。竇建德生於五七三年，被擒時四十八歲，押送長安後又十三年，至貞觀八年（634年）受賜而死。
dataEn: Few figures survive that can be checked, but the main ones are clear. The size of the Xia host is given identically by the Zizhi Tongjian and the Jiu Tangshu as 'a little over a hundred thousand, proclaimed as three hundred thousand'; the true strength was around a hundred thousand, cavalry being what Dou relied upon, with infantry in the majority. On the Tang side the main body of the eastern campaign was assembled on two lines, from Guanzhong and from Luoyang, and numbered in the tens of thousands, with cavalry as the spearhead, supported by crossbowmen and foot drawn up in line. The results are explicitly recorded: over three thousand severed heads, more than fifty thousand prisoners, a pursuit of thirty li, and Dou Jiande taken after being struck by an arrow. The hours of the action are given as running from the hour of the dragon until midday, that is from about seven in the morning until noon, the Xia line standing in place for two double-hours without advancing, its men hungry and thirsty. As for distances, Hulao Pass lay some tens of li east of Luoyang, while Dou Jiande had marched several hundred li south from Leshou in Hebei, his supply line stretched to its limit. As for dating, the battle is entered under the xin-si day of the fifth month of the fourth year of Wude (621 AD); modern calculations usually place it in late May of that year, though the lunisolar conversion varies slightly between authorities, the battle certainly belonging to the opening months of that summer. Dou Jiande, born in 573, was forty-eight when he was taken; he was sent to Chang'an and lived another thirteen years before being granted death in the eighth year of Zhenguan (634).
cause: 這一仗的起因，是隋末崩解之後唐、夏、鄭三家在中原與河北的一場結構性對撞。隋亡之後，竇建德在河北以鄉兵起家，先後平定河北諸股勢力，建立夏國，自稱夏王；他的地盤與唐的關中相隔甚遠，中間隔著王世充的洛陽。唐則在關中收拾了關隴集團，握有足以支撐遠征的兵力、糧秣與馬匹，並挾滅劉黑闥之聲勢進取河北。唐太宗判斷得十分清楚：竇建德若坐河北不動，河北終非一朝可取，必先破夏，才能孤立洛陽；而夏若傾巢援鄭，唐夏兩家一旦合流，關中與河北之間便再無寧日。於是唐遣使往來，名通款曲，實則偵察；同時整軍東進，先掃衛州，再據虎牢險要，迫竇建德來援，把決戰的戰場與主動權牢牢握在自己手中。竇建德亦有自己的算盤：他的士眾久經河北消耗，亟需一場勝利來鞏固王位；而唐軍主力遠在關中，只要他傾力東出，河北的後方便等於空虛。兩家相互試探，最終在一座關隘前以決戰收場。
causeEn: The cause of this war was the structural collision of Tang, Xia and Zheng in the Central Plain and in Hebei after the Sui order came apart. After the fall of the Sui, Dou Jiande raised a host of local villagers in Hebei, put down the various competing bands in turn, built the state of Xia and proclaimed himself king; his territory lay far from the Tang base at Guanzhong, with Wang Shichong's Luoyang in between. Tang, for its part, had taken over the Guanlong group in Guanzhong and held the troops, grain and horses needed to support a distant campaign, and pressed into Hebei on the momentum of Liu Heita's defeat. Li Shimin judged the matter with unusual clarity: if Dou sat still in Hebei, Hebei could not be taken in a day, so Xia had to be broken first and Luoyang isolated; and if Xia threw everything into relieving Zheng, once Tang and Xia moved together there would be no peace between Guanzhong and Hebei. So Tang sent envoys back and forth, professing goodwill while in fact spying, and at the same time mustered the army to march east, clearing Weizhou first and then occupying the strong ground at Hulao, forcing Dou Jiande to come to them and holding both the field of decision and the initiative firmly in his own hands. Dou Jiande had his own calculation as well: his troops had long been worn down by the fighting in Hebei and he badly needed a victory to hold his throne; and with the Tang main body far away in Guanzhong, if he marched out in force his own rear would be left empty. Two sides tested one another, and the matter was settled by a set-piece battle in front of a pass.
impact: 虎牢一役的後果，超出一座關隘所能承載的份量。夏國覆亡，竇建德被押入長安，河北州縣一併歸唐，《舊唐書》記以「建德既平，河北悉平」。河北是隋唐之際戶口與賦稅最重的區域之一，州縣重歸中央編戶，河北的豪強與流民被重新編入府兵與州縣的體系，唐朝自此握有經營北方所必需的人力與物資，這是比一場會戰更為長久的收穫。對唐太宗個人而言，此戰一舉奠定其軍功的頂點：戰後數月以尚書令總攬軍國庶事，而太子李建成、齊王李元吉的忌憚亦由此加深，兄弟間的矛盾五年後演成玄武門之變——虎牢的功業，間接成了那場宮廷變亂的伏線。對戰局而言，洛陽的王世充失去外援，武德五年二月出降，唐軍據有洛陽，關中、中原、河北連成一氣；再往後數年東突厥被滅，貞觀年間的統一格局由此鋪開。就兵學而言，此役也留下一份極簡的樣本：據險而待、疲敵而戰、以精騎反轉陣線，一日之內解決了原本要拖上一年半載的河北問題，後世談「以逸待勞」與「批亢搗虛」，多半會援引虎牢為例。
impactEn: What followed at Hulao weighed far more than a pass could hold. The state of Xia was destroyed, Dou Jiande was taken to Chang'an, and the prefectures of Hebei returned to Tang; the Jiu Tangshu puts it in a single line: 'Dou Jiande is destroyed, and Hebei is wholly pacified.' Hebei was one of the heaviest regions of population and revenue in the late Sui and early Tang; its prefectures were brought back under central registration, its local magnates and displaced people were reabsorbed into the fubing and the administrative system, and the dynasty thereby acquired the manpower and materials it needed to govern the north — a harvest that would outlast any single battle. For Li Shimin himself the victory placed the capstone on his military reputation: within months he was made Director of the Department of State Affairs and took charge of the affairs of state and army, and the jealousy of the crown prince Li Jiancheng and of the Prince of Qi Li Yuanji deepened accordingly; the quarrel between the brothers broke into the Xuanwu Gate incident five years later, so that the laurels of Hulao became, in a sense, the underlay of that coup in the palace. For the war itself, the loss of his last support left Wang Shichong isolated at Luoyang, and in the second month of the fifth year of Wude he surrendered, giving Tang Luoyang and joining the capital, the Central Plain and Hebei into one connected body; a few years later the Eastern Turks were destroyed and the unified order of the Zhenguan years was built out from that base. For the art of war the campaign is also a spare and instructive specimen: hold the strong ground, wait for the enemy to tire, then turn his line with picked cavalry — a problem in Hebei that would have taken a year or more of attrition settled inside a single day. Later writers on waiting at ease and on striking at the enemy's weak point reach for Hulao more often than for almost any other battle.
result: 戰果由《舊唐書》與《資治通鑑》記載得相當清楚：竇建德列陣自辰時至午時不得進，士卒飢渴行列散亂，李世民遣三百騎登坡鼓噪而自引精騎捲旗疾進，衝其陣後，唐軍步騎大進，夏軍當即崩潰；追奔三十里，斬首三千餘級，俘虜五萬餘人，竇建德中流矢，匿於牛渚渚中而被擒，一軍之帥與大批部眾同時落入唐手。竇建德被解送長安，太宗封其為河南公，一說又賜夏王，禮數頗厚；然其終以不臣，貞觀八年（634年）在長安被賜死，行刑時神色自若，至死不屈。就戰役本身而言，這是一場乾淨俐落的全勝：沒有拉鋸，沒有攻城的消耗，一日之間，河北的割據勢力被從根上拔除。它留下的最大遺產，是一個剛建立的王朝用一年時間解決了北方、再用數年時間鋪開統一格局的樣本；此後唐軍再未遇到同等規模的地方割據武裝，直到對高句麗與吐蕃的邊疆戰爭開啟另一個階段。
resultEn: The result is set down with unusual clarity in the Jiu Tangshu and the Zizhi Tongjian. Dou Jiande drew up his line from the hour of the dragon until noon without advancing, his men hungry, thirsty and out of order; Li Shimin sent three hundred horsemen to the slope to beat the drums and then led his picked cavalry forward with the flags furled, struck the rear of the Xia line, and the Tang foot and horse drove in, and the Xia host broke at once. The pursuit ran thirty li, over three thousand were killed, more than fifty thousand were taken prisoner, Dou Jiande was struck by an arrow and hid in the marsh at Niuzhu, where he was taken; the commander of the army and a great part of his force fell into Tang hands together. Dou Jiande was taken to Chang'an, where the emperor enfeoffed him as Duke of Henan — some accounts add that he was also granted the title of King of Xia — and the honours paid him were not small; yet he never became submissive, and in the eighth year of Zhenguan (634) he was granted death in Chang'an, meeting the end with a steady face and refusing to yield. As a battle the result is a clean and total victory: no grinding, no losses spent against walls, and in a single day the separatist power in Hebei was torn out by the root. Its greatest inheritance was the example of a young dynasty that settled the north within a year and unfolded a unified order within a few more; after Hulao the Tang armies did not meet a separatist force of comparable scale again until the frontier wars against Goguryeo and Tibet opened a different chapter.
